measure: Opposite-sex marriages, all previous legal marital statuses combined
source_product: Marriages in England and Wales: 2019, Figure 2b
source_units: Marriages per 1000 unmarried women per year
interpolation: Piecewise linear between finite group midpoints 18, 22.5, 27.5, ..., 62.5. Evaluate at single-year interval midpoints age_start + 0.5. Hold the nearest endpoint rate outside these midpoints within ages 16 to 64. Divide by 1000.
open_age_group: Retain the published 65+ rate as [65, Inf), without single-year interpolation.
outside_support: No rows below age 16; no inferred rates there.
limitations: Illustrative union-search input derived from legal marriage rates, not observed search hazards or rates of all unions.
Unmarried legally can include cohabiting women, unlike the simulation unpartnered risk set.
Interpolated values are estimates, not ONS single-year observations; interpolation does not preserve exposure-weighted grouped rates without age-specific exposure.
No distinction by current marital status or union order.
